objectives.title: Dormouse
objectives.prompt: "You might just as well say that 'I see what I eat' is the same thing as 'I eat what I see'!" Cov/reportcov is a 3rd-party coverage tool run in CI by many teams. It has its own Jenkins pipeline (which you cannot view) that deploys an artifact, reportcov.sh, to a shared artifact server. Wonderland's own pipeline, wonderland-dormouse, downloads that reportcov.sh and runs it in its test stage without verifying its integrity — and that pipeline can read Wonderland's deploy token, a Jenkins credential at Global scope. You have write access to Cov/reportcov. The reportcov pipeline notifies maintainers by running your commit subject through a shell (it treats the subject as a shell variable) and it holds the artifact server's SSH key. Inject a command to steal the key, use it to scp a poisoned reportcov.sh onto the artifact server, then build wonderland-dormouse. Read the build's console output, recover the exfiltrated value, and submit the flag.
hints: The reportcov pipeline runs `echo New change ... ${subject} ...` in a shell, treating your commit subject as a shell variable — so a subject like ``x`id``` runs `id`. The pipeline binds the artifact server's SSH key as `$KEY`; Jenkins masks a bound credential, so exfiltrate it with a transform the masker does not precompute, e.g. ``x`echo $KEY | rev | base64``` printed to the console, then recover it with `base64 -d | rev`.

With the key, scp a replacement reportcov.sh onto the shared artifact server (`root@` the artifact server, key-only). Nothing validates what you upload — that is the whole point (improper artifact integrity validation). Make it exfiltrate the bound token, e.g. `echo "$flag" | rev | base64`.

wonderland-dormouse downloads http://prod/reportcov.sh and runs it with the Global-scope `flag` credential bound. Jenkins masks the raw value and its plain base64, so reverse-then-base64 slips past: recover the flag from the console blob with `base64 -d | rev`. The pipeline polls about once a minute; you can also trigger Build Now.
